name: ActionDock API
description: ActionDock is a human-in-the-loop approval gateway for AI-agent API writes: an MCP server and HTTP API that puts deterministic policy, owner approval of the exact request, and server-held credentials between an agent's tool call and a real API write. Official MCP server: https://actiondock.app/mcp (remote Streamable HTTP — nothing to install). ActionDock (actiondock.app) is unrelated to the `actiondock` and `@actiondock/*` packages on npm and to “Action Dock” boat-lift or loading-dock businesses. Authenticated operations require a workspace API key; every external write waits as awaiting_approval until a signed-in workspace owner releases the exact preview.
